nodes.text: Well. Still upright. The incident book remains disappointed. What?

choices.text: Fine — tell me about the lamps.

nodes.text: Ha. There it is. Fernway, the Long Meadow, the Fork — walk lamp to lamp, sleep behind their walls, and past Edda's light go armed, fed, and *morning-minded*. Took you long enough. The book forgives you; so, provisionally, do I.

Meaner than yesterday, kinder than tomorrow. The middle stretch has Redmask sign again. You want particulars, buy Dunna's stew and listen for whichever table's talking quietest — the quiet table always knows.
Try to stay off my paperwork.
